description: This file defines an interface `ApiFacingEnum` used for enums that can be represented as `StringEnumOptionData`. It includes static methods for converting enum classes to lists of options and retrieving specific options by name, facilitating API field representations and options handling.

classes.name: ApiFacingEnum
classes.description: An interface for enums that can provide string options for API representations, with static utility methods.

methods.name: getValuesAsStringEnumOptionDataList
methods.description: Converts an enum class implementing ApiFacingEnum into a list of StringEnumOptionData objects.

methods.name: getStringEnumOptionData
methods.description: Retrieves a StringEnumOptionData for a given enum class and name, or returns null if name is invalid.

methods.name: getValueAsStringEnumOptionData
methods.description: Default method returning the StringEnumOptionData representation of the enum instance.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns a code string for the enum value; intended to be implemented by enum classes.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for the enum value; intended to be implemented by enum classes.
